name: Mizugameza Akanoa
source:
Lover of humanity and eccentric genius, the Prince of Aquarius.

He loves the science of Earth and is a self-proclaimed genius inventor. He loves clothes and fashion, but he’s messy, hates taking baths, and his clothes are always wrinkled. His personality is eccentric, but at first glance he is friendly and philanthropic. However, once he loses interest in someone he turns distant and cold. He only shows his true feelings in very rare circumstances.
